RESULT `/work/putnam_2005_b5.lean` compiles with no errors and no `sorry` warning. The only warnings are linter notes: an unused `npos`, and some unused simp arguments.

The theorem statement, imports and docstring are unchanged. The proof replaces the `sorry` and uses no axioms, `native_decide`, `#eval` or metaprogramming.

The argument is a Fischer-type inner product. Define B(f, g) = Σ_α f_α · α! · g_α, where α! is the product of the factorials of the exponents. Then:

- **Adjointness:** B(x_i·Q, P) = B(Q, ∂_i P). This is proved on monomials and extended by linearity.
- **Divisibility:** If P = (Σ x_i²)·Q, then B(P, P) = Σ_i B(Q, ∂_i² P). The sum vanishes because P is harmonic, so B(P, P) = 0.
- **Positivity:** B(P, P) is a sum of non-negative terms, one for each monomial of P. If it is zero, every coefficient of P is zero, so P = 0.

RESULT The Lean proof in `/work/putnam_2005_b5.lean` is complete.
